info.name: Smart Space Booking - Backend API (UKK RPL Paket B)
info.description:
Backend REST API aplikasi reservasi coworking space (Smart Space Booking) - UKK RPL 2026/2027 Paket B.

Teknologi: Laravel 13 + Laravel Sanctum Bearer Token + MySQL.

Fitur Postman:
- Otomatis menyimpan token ke collection variable dan environment variable saat eksekusi Login.
- Semua request telah dilengkapi header Accept: application/json.

Akun demo:
- Admin: admin_demo / Admin123!
- Member: budi.member, siti.member, agus.member / Member123!
